prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Create ONE polished full-screen portrait mobile game daily rewards popup concept, "Concept 1 — Lưới 3x2 cân đối", for an idle racing game. Canvas aspect ratio 886:1920 (390x845 logical). Straight-on flat UI screenshot, no device frame. Use the provided reference image as STYLE and CONTENT reference: same glossy miniature ticket and magenta gem visual identities, cyan gift header, orange claim button; redesign spacing and cards as specified below.
Style: Soft Miniature: warm cream/beige rounded panel, soft thick rounded edges, subtle small shadows, glossy toy-like 3D reward icons, dark navy Vietnamese rounded bold typography. High-quality shippable game UI. Restrained compact balanced composition, minimal wasted space. Popup fills portrait screen with tiny darkened game backdrop margins.
Top: bright cyan rounded header with glossy red gift box / gold bow at left, exact text "QUÀ HẰNG NGÀY", red rounded close button "X" right. Below exact subtitle "Đăng nhập mỗi ngày, nhận quà cực chất!" then centered blue pill "Đã nhận: 0 ngày".
Main area: EXACTLY SIX equal-size rounded cards in a balanced 3-column by 2-row grid. Large centered icon occupies approximately 60% of each card. Small top ribbon labels "Ngày 1", "Ngày 2", "Ngày 3", "Ngày 4", "Ngày 5", "Ngày 6". Quantity is a clearly legible small round/pill badge overlapping lower-right of each reward icon. No reward names, no units, ONLY the quantity number in each card besides the day label and today's label.
Row one: Ngày 1 blue Pro ticket icon with badge "2", warm yellow highlighted card and small "HÔM NAY" label; Ngày 2 pale blue Standard ticket icon with badge "2"; Ngày 3 magenta gem icon badge "15".
Row two: Ngày 4 purple/gold All-Star ticket icon badge "1"; Ngày 5 gold/purple Elite ticket icon badge "1"; Ngày 6 magenta gem icon badge "20".
Below grid: full-width cyan rounded special day card with gold trim. Top text "NGÀY 7 · QUÀ ĐẶC BIỆT". Glossy gift box on left and two reward groups centered/right: magenta gem with quantity "30", plus symbol, purple/gold All-Star ticket with quantity "2". Reward quantities only; no reward names. DO NOT include a completion strip or the text "Hoàn thành 7 ngày để nhận".
Below: compact accumulation section heading "QUÀ TÍCH LŨY" and blue progress pill "0/10 ngày". A horizontal beige progress track with 4 equally spaced circular milestones and four readable reward columns underneath: "Ngày 10" gem icon with "40"; "Ngày 20" All-Star ticket icon with "2"; "Ngày 30" gem icon "80" + All-Star ticket icon "2"; "Ngày 40" gem icon "40". Use icons + numbers only, without the words gem or vé. Fit each column cleanly without text collision. No extra instruction/progress text.
Bottom: generous full-width glossy orange rounded button with small glossy gift icon and exact white uppercase text "NHẬN QUÀ".
All Vietnamese text rendered accurately with accents. Exact copy only as listed. Keep everything fully inside canvas, readable and balanced. No logos, no watermark, no additional labels. Critical: all SIX daily cards same dimensions; each has large centered icon and numeric quantity badge; never write "gem", "vé Pro", "vé Standard", "vé All-Star", "vé Elite" or any reward name anywhere.
output_processing: Resampled generated concept to requested portrait dimensions.
